note: Indoor starting gates, not a fit on the real camera. Hue is degrees (twice an OpenCV hue). Red is two ranges because hue wraps through 0°: [0, 20] and [340, 360] are OpenCV about 0–10 and 170–180. Blue [200, 260] is OpenCV about 100–130. Saturation and value are 0–255 floors so a dim or slightly washed patch still counts and gray walls do not. Recalibrate under the room lights the way fly-car fits color_thresholds.json. Warm bulbs can push red toward orange and blue toward purple; widen the open end of a range if the panel is missed, and raise saturation if wood or skin counts as red.
